verdict.rationale: Viam's RDK has a public GitHub repository (viamrobotics/rdk) with runnable source, e.g. `go run ./web/cmd/server`, so the core source can be read. The pack never states which license covers it, and one community user was unsure how much of Viam is open source, which lowers confidence but is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the RDK, clarity on which components (cloud app, registry, SDKs) are open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Example with a dummy configuration: `go run ./web/cmd/server -config etc/configs/fake.json`.
Multiple SDKs are available for writing client applications that interface with the Viam RDK.
